name: report-mode-evidence-preservation
description: Benchmarks focused on whether report-mode explorer output preserves machine-readable citations, cited file diversity, and clean evidence reliability signals.

cases.description: Confirm explore returns structured citations and citation-derived targets for report-mode analysis.

args.prompt: Explain how report-mode citations are extracted and returned for explore output. Cite the implementation and at least one test file using backticked file references that include a line range (for example `path/to/file.ext:L10-L20`).

expectations.label: Citation targets include implementation or tests

checks.label: Preserves at least two cited files
